original_card.question: Can a template or call contract leave two or more unpaid coordinates per live family?
methods: State a replacement for the coverage identity (mass = 72W + 64N) and the contract change that realizes it, with its implementation cost.
Find an obstruction: show which data-endpoint obligation forces exactly one unpaid coordinate in the current template.
original_card.acceptance_gate: An explicit replacement identity, verified on a small complete instance with dirty inputs, priced with ceiling.ceiling(unpaid=...).

first_step.inspect: Read the selected word's per-call local profile, its packing ceiling and the lever table; run levers.py for the ideal budget of the lever you target.
first_step.scope: Positive control and planning budget only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Explain where the single unpaid coordinate per family comes from in the hosted template; propose one change and price it. Ideal budget: two unpaid coordinates per family is 3.77x (levers.py).
original_card.bottleneck_link: The deficit is one coordinate per family minus the centre charge; doubling unpaid coordinates per family scales it directly.
allowed_variations: One template change or one endpoint-contract change.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Counting a coordinate as unpaid while leaving it unadvanced in the data endpoint.

actual_scope: Code-disjoint reconstruction of the pinned PR589/PR555-lineage bit word's paid-rank mass accounting from its gate operations: frame dimensions by exact rational rank of the live line closures, per-register net frame climbs (X 7, Y 7, helpers 8) summing to 8R + 14v = 5066, plus the recorded nine copy ranks (63) reproducing word.legality.rank_mass = 5129 = 8R + 63 + 14v, with cross-consistency of word.local_histogram and nine.profile at aggregate level.
scope_change_reason: The drawn coverage-law-change card's headline objects (plane-port coverage law, two-unpaid-coordinate templates) are saturated with fresh claims and PRs (discussions 1516/1587; https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1825, https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1808, https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1900), and the sibling agent completed connector-alphabet-change (https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2056). This object is the unclaimed first step the repository itself names for the bit-side coverage law (research/selected-suppliers-de-diagnostic open question 2): ctoth's discussion-1587 finding derives the bit identity mass = 63W + 63N but marks the hosted bit template step inferred, and the aggregates it uses have no from-operations audit. Question and method are a narrowing of the card's coverage-identity audit to the bit word's deficit accounting.
bottleneck_link: The bit side supplies the binding supplier's required budget multiplier; the coverage identity D = 64W - rank_mass = W - 63N = 10272 and every bit-side coverage-law or repacking argument rests on the paid-rank mass aggregate. Re-deriving that aggregate from operations removes the last un-audited input of research/selected-suppliers-de-diagnostic's pricing and pins down which part of the accounting is word-geometric and which part remains emitter-level.
stop_rule: 30 minutes of computation; stop at the first aggregate that cannot be re-derived from the word file without the supplier's emitter (stage_cohort.py + legality_h.cpp + C++/Boost), and record that boundary as the exact obstruction instead of restating the checker.
evidence: research/bit-ledger-frame-ranks-seedfeb2/verify.py prints PASS_BIT_LEDGER_FRAME_RANKS: pinned word file/content sha256; frame dimension spectrum {0:1, 1:111, 2:153, 4:70, 6:180, 7:120, 8:1} over the 636 label frames; X-slot and Y-slot net climbs all 7 (111 each), helper net climbs all 8 (439); total net climb 5066 = 8R + 14v; nine retained totals with recorded copy ranks 7 each giving 63; rank_mass 5129 = 8R + 63 + 14v matching word.legality.rank_mass; local_histogram weighted sum 5129; nine.profile weighted sum 1808352 = 64W - (W - 63N). Five semantic mutation controls are rejected. The 2920-record local_histogram refinement and the emitter-level record stream are not re-derived (see README limits).

open_questions.question: Can the 2920-record paid histogram word.local_histogram be decomposed into per-record MOVE prices and the nine COPY ranks directly from the A/B/C/D gate streams and the frame menu, without the emitter's register-level expansion?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It would complete the from-operations rebuild of nine.profile's inputs and turn the recorded histogram into a checkable consequence of the word file.
open_questions.first_step: Read the gate-frame convention in research/e8-bit-carrier-skeleton/code/ pwordl.py (gate(F, dst, srcs), climb(r, F)) and reconstruct each register's frame trajectory from the serialized A/B/C/D lists, then compare the induced MOVE-price histogram with word.local_histogram.
open_questions.blocked_by: The paid-rank charging convention is defined by the emitter's event stream (COHORT249-RECORDS.bin via stage_cohort.py) and legality_h.cpp; the word file does not carry per-record frames for free ADDs, so the trajectory reconstruction is a substantial piece of work (the original blocker of research/selected-suppliers-de-diagnostic open question 2).

open_questions.question: Is the nine-element copy-rank block (7 each) derivable from the punctured-hyperplane geometry of the nine punctured labels, as exact frame dimensions, rather than taken from the recorded xcheck block?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It would make the 63 term of rank_mass = 8R + 63 + 14v fully from-operations and tighten the link between the decoder constant 63 and the label geometry.
open_questions.first_step: For each punctured label p in word.punctured, form the closed live line set of the p-punctured hyperplane and compute its exact rank; compare with the recorded copy rank 7.
open_questions.blocked_by: The mapping from punctured labels to the nine retained totals' copy frames is defined in the supplier's emitter/xcheck, not spelled out in the word file.
